_doc: BLINDSPOT-1 need backup-restore, read by foundation/backup.py. Every D1 database and KV namespace in the account is exported weekly, each SQL dump is restored into a scratch SQLite database and compared with the live row counts, and the dumps are stored in the R2 bucket and read back. exclude_tables hold sealed credentials: they are left out of the dump and named in the record, and are re-minted through /connect after a restore. keep is the number of copies kept per store. account_id pins the drill to the Ultrastable account named in doctrine/topology.json: the workflow's CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID secret points at a different account that holds other projects' personal databases, and the first drill (2026-11-20) backed those up by mistake; the copies were deleted. A resource outside this account is never read.
